name: query_sql
description: This eval set contains conversations that test the agent's ability to query a database using SQL.

parts.text: In May 2026, which 10 locations had the worst air quality, as measured by the highest average PM10?

Here are the top 10 locations with the worst air quality in **May 2026**, ranked by the highest average daily $\text{PM}_{10}$ concentrations ($\mu\text{g/m}^3$):

| Rank | Location / City | County, State | Monitoring Site / Address | Avg $\text{PM}_{10}$ ($\mu\text{g/m}^3$) |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| **1** | Buffalo | Scott County, Iowa | BUFFALO, LW MINING (11100 110TH AVE. DAVENPORT) | **42.46** |
| **2** | Fort McDowell | Maricopa County, Arizona | Fort McDowell/Yuma Frank (18791 Yuma Frank Road) | **37.55** |
| **3** | Fort Dodge | Webster County, Iowa | Day Park (107 South 15th St) | **33.94** |
| **4** | *Not in a city* | Bannock County, Idaho | BALLARD ROAD | **26.86** |
| **5** | Des Moines | Polk County, Iowa | CARPENTER (1907 CARPENTER) | **25.47** |
| **6** | Cedar Rapids | Linn County, Iowa | Public Health (500 11TH ST NW) | **23.13** |
| **7** | Salt Lake City | Salt Lake County, Utah | Utah Technical Center (240 N 1950 W) | **22.18** |
| **8** | Magna | Salt Lake County, Utah | UTM COORDINATES AT PROBE LOCATION (12100 W 1200 S) | **20.60** |
| **9** | Weeping Water | Cass County, Nebraska | CITY SANITATION BLDG | **20.19** |
| **10** | *Not in a city* | Fresno County, California | Table Mountain Air Monitoring Site | **20.12** |

Please let me know if you would like additional details or further analysis!

  "explain": "To find the 10 locations with the worst air quality (highest average PM10) in May 2026, we query `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm10_daily_summary`. We filter records where `date_local` is within May 2026 ('2026-05-01' to '2026-05-31'), group by the location attributes (`state_name`, `county_name`, `city_name`, `local_site_name`, `address`), calculate the average daily PM10 reading (`AVG(arithmetic_mean)`), and order the results descending to get the top 10 highest locations.",
